description: Retrieve a list of relevant websites using Brave Search API
name: brave_search

description: Fetch a webpage and return its readable content as markdown. Use for reading articles, documentation, search results, or any page the user asks about. HTML is converted to markdown; long documents are truncated — call again with the suggested start_index to read further.

max_length.description: Maximum number of characters to return (default: 10000).

start_index.description: Character offset to start reading from (default: 0). A truncated response says which start_index to pass to continue.

url.description: The URL to fetch. Only http:// and https:// URLs are supported.

name: fetch_webpage

description: Generate an image from a text prompt and return the filepath and URL link to the image.

prompt.description: The text prompt to generate an image from, written as tags. eg: mountain, snow, realistic

name: generate_image

description: Get weather forecast and astronomy data for a location

location.description: City name, ZIP code, or coordinates

name: get_weather_forecast

description: Send an image (and optional text prompt) to the vision LLM for analysis. Use for camera snapshots, photos, screenshots, etc.

image_url.description: HTTP(S) URL to an image. Common formats supported (PNG, JPEG, WebP). The vision service fetches the URL itself.

text.description: The text prompt describing what to analyze in the image (e.g. 'describe what you see', 'is anyone in this image?').

name: query_multimodal_api

description: Search Wikipedia for information about a topic and return a summary.
name: search_wikipedia

description: Send a Signal message (text, optionally with images or short videos) to the homeowner.

items.description: URL (auto-downloaded) or local file path of an image or short video to attach.

name: send_signal_message

description: Query Wolfram Alpha for answers to factual questions
name: wolfram_alpha
